accepted_scope: Installed Windows, Linux and macOS snapshot fields, availability/identity classes, cancellation, thread/reentrancy rules and per-call store immutability
installed_consumers: C++ independent recomputation and thread probe (compare.cpp)

build_sources.package: apps/reader/book-information installed into a private prefix; consumers compiled only from that prefix

same_run_evidence.method: workflow evidence job re-listed run/jobs/artifacts through the API, downloaded and unzipped every platform ZIP in the cloud, recomputed the SHA-256 of the downloaded bytes, rejected missing/duplicate/cross-source artifacts and required the same 22 named verdicts on all three platforms

acceptance_includes: Nine product-only formats read with no SDK object: cloud-only availability, no identity claim, no parser fields
Local mapping missing, identity by size only and identity by SHA-256 are distinct, and a wrong book of equal or unequal size is refused
PDF pages/Info metadata, CBZ ComicInfo properties, EPUB bounded/global storage modes and reflow no-public-fields are separated from product fields
Non-ASCII titles, authors and property values survive both providers round trip
Text caps cut only at UTF-8 scalar boundaries with flags; the 32-property cap counts omissions instead of dropping them silently
Cancellation at every poll position of a verified parsed read, including inside the SDK call, returns CANCELLED with no snapshot
The snapshot stays readable after the catalog, library, source and fixed document are closed
A second C++ consumer recomputes every field from the public catalog and SDK APIs and compares it with the snapshot
Foreign-thread use is refused, the view is immutable and pointer-stable, and a cancel callback that re-enters is refused as REENTRANT
Every read leaves both stores byte-identical in-process (whole-file FNV-1a plus size around the module call)

failure_iterations_retained.reason: commit message amended before the guard ran; superseded, kept for the record
public header declared READER_BOOK_INFORMATION_IDENTITY_MISMATCH twice (gcc error, MSVC C2365); macOS job cancelled after the two failures

the 240000-paragraph cancellation fixture exceeded the SDK document node budget, so every case reported a setup failure at import (EXR_LIMIT)
fixture generator wrote str instead of bytes: TypeError before any case ran
two product rows were mapped to one local SDK ID; reader_catalog_attach refused with SQLITE_CONSTRAINT (19)
same single-SDK-row conflict re-confirmed on all three platforms
harness crashed on a NULL parser_title (AttributeError) and wrote no report
the fb2 book_key prefix was rejected as malformed; PDF parser_title was asserted to carry the Info title; the SDK-ID leak check matched by substring inside hexadecimal digests
the fb2 prefix and leak-check defects were still present; only the PDF title expectations had been corrected
all three platform jobs succeeded; the evidence job rejected every ZIP because the digest comparison compared 'sha256:'+digest with the hex half
